what: Spec round one: a name rejected as a path had no scenario or control-flow branch, the fallback path never forbade a package runner, the caller copy order and the quiet report had no witness, and the caller-line scenario tested nothing the node ships. Swept every rule in the draft skill for a scenario, shipped the caller line in the skill folder README, added a Validate section, and named the npx exception to the launcher rule.

Spec round two: the never-read-a-tier-folder rule had no witness on the path where the command did not run, and the absent-skill scenario asserted model default behaviour no shipped text carries. Put a differing repository override in the did-not-run scenario, dropped the unanchored clause, recorded the departures from the issue, and named the load-reference exception where the launcher rule lives.
